title: Why OpenAI Could Disrupt A $700 Billion Industry
description:
OpenAI and other AI companies are creating a shift that could impact one of the world's largest professional services industries.

For decades, consulting firms like McKinsey & Company, Accenture, Deloitte, and Boston Consulting Group built enormous businesses around expertise, analysis, and strategic guidance.

AI is changing the economics of that model.

Today, advanced systems can help organizations analyze data, generate recommendations, build business cases, and accelerate decision-making at unprecedented speed.

In this video, we explore:

• Why AI threatens traditional information advantages
• How consulting business models may evolve
• The future of knowledge-based professions
• What skills become more valuable in an AI-driven economy
• Why execution may become the ultimate competitive advantage

The biggest AI disruption may not be automation.

It may be the democratization of expertise itself.
